meta.title: About Us
meta.description: QuickLocal connects {city} with trusted local shops and fairly paid riders.

story.title: Started on one street. Built for every one.

where.title: Where we operate
where.text: One city, honestly stated. The map grows when the vendors do.
where.categoriesTitle: Categories a shop can open under

statement.text: Convenience for the customer should never come out of the seller's margin or the rider's pocket.

principles.title: Four commitments, written into the platform.
principles.intro: Each of these is a value the backend enforces, not a line on a slide.

items.title: Every fee in writing
items.text: What a shop pays to list and what a customer pays for delivery are written down before anyone commits. Convenience for the customer should not come out of the seller's margin.

items.title: The rider keeps the fee
items.text: Every delivery pays {base} for the first {freeKm} km and about ₹{perKm} a kilometre after — and the whole fee reaches the rider. Not a per-drop lottery.

items.title: Nobody operates unverified
items.text: Every shop and every rider clears document verification — the papers their role and their vehicle actually call for — before a single order.

items.title: {hours} hours, and we mean it
items.text: {hours} hours is the platform's hard ceiling on any order, inside a {radius} km default radius.

banner.title: Own a shop in {city}?
banner.text: List free, set your own free-delivery threshold, and get paid after every delivered order.

meta.title: Services
meta.description: Every category a local shop can open under on {name}, and how delivery works.

hero.title: Everything your neighbourhood already sells.
hero.intro: {Aisles} categories, delivered inside {radius} km by default and within {hours} hours, always.

items.label: As far as you can widen it

referral.title: Refer a friend, save ₹{referral}.
referral.text: When their first order lands, ₹{referral} comes off your next one. The amount is set by the platform, so it is the same for everybody.

detail.deliveryTitle: Delivery, from the shop to you
detail.deliveryNote: Free over the shop's own threshold — {threshold} until it sets one.

events.title: And when there is an occasion, a seventh tab.
events.text: Festivals and seasonal sales open as events beside the aisles, with offers from the shops for as long as they run.

radius.title: Choose how far your street reaches.
radius.intro: Every saved address starts at {radius} km. Widen it, a step at a time, up to {maxRadius} km — and see what that means for the area you can order from and for delivery.
radius.label: Delivery radius
radius.edge: Delivery from a shop at the edge
radius.steps: Steps of {step} km, saved per address
radius.note: Delivery is worked out per order from the shop's real distance to you; a shop nearer than your edge costs less. The per-km rate follows the day's fuel price.

meta.title: For Business
meta.description: Sell on {name} or deliver for it — free to list, and the whole delivery fee for every rider.

hero.title: Sell on it, or deliver for it.
hero.intro: Two ways to work with {name}, each with its numbers stated up front — and a page of its own for each.

vendors.title: Become a vendor
vendors.text: List your shop, set your catalogue, and get paid to your bank. Start on the free plan — {freeProducts} products, no monthly cost.

partners.title: Become a delivery partner
partners.text: Jobs reach you as offers after the shop accepts — see the distances and the fee, then take only the ones you want.

earnings.title: What a delivery pays.
earnings.intro: A rider is paid the order's whole delivery fee — set by the platform and applied to every order, so it does not move shop to shop.
earnings.example: A {sampleKm} km delivery pays {sampleFee}: the {base} base, plus {sampleExtra} for the {sampleExtraKm} km past {freeKm}. Per-km follows the day's fuel price.

meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Vendor plans on {name} — from free to ₹{proPrice} a month. Change or cancel any month.

hero.title: Plans for every shop.
hero.intro: A monthly plan decides how much you can list and which tools you get. Start free, move up when it pays, and change or cancel any month.

meta.title: Get the App
meta.description: Sell on {name} or deliver for it — both start in the app. Here is what onboarding looks like for each.

hero.title: It all starts in the app.
hero.intro: Selling or delivering both need document verification, so both are done in the app rather than on a web form. Install it, pick your role, and you are a few screens from live.
hero.question: Questions first?

banner.title: Verified once, then you are live.
banner.text: Every shop and every rider clears document checks before taking an order — which is the reason a customer can trust the one that turns up.

hero.title: Talk to a person.
hero.intro: Whether you want to sell, deliver, or ask about an order — these all reach someone.

channels.title: Call us
channels.note: For anything urgent about a live order

follow.title: Follow along
follow.text: New neighbourhoods and new categories get announced here first.

noForm.title: Why there is no form here
noForm.text: This site is static — nothing on it stores what you type. A contact form would take your message and lose it, so we send you to a mailbox somebody reads instead.

meta.title: How It Works
meta.description: Follow one order on {name} from the first tap to the code at your door — every step, and what the platform does at each.

hero.title: From the shelf to your door, step by step.
hero.intro: One order, followed end to end — what you see, what the shop and the rider see, and the rules the platform holds everyone to along the way.

journey.title: Eight moments between a tap and a knock.

steps.title: Find the shop down the road.
steps.text: The app shows open, verified shops within {radius} km of the address you are ordering to. Widen it to {maxRadius} km, four kilometres at a time.

steps.title: Pay, and see every rupee first.
steps.text: Your basket and your share of delivery, nothing else, all shown before you pay. Payment goes through Razorpay, and an order left unpaid is cancelled after thirty minutes so its stock goes back on the shelf.

steps.title: The shop says yes.
steps.text: A verified shop confirms it has everything and starts packing — and only now does the order go out to riders. Until pickup, you or the shop can still cancel, and anything authorised is released.

steps.title: A rider says yes, too.
steps.text: Only once the shop has accepted is a rider looked for — and the job arrives as an offer, not an order. The rider sees the shop, you, every distance and the fee, and has a minute to accept or pass; a pass sends it to the next rider. If nobody accepts within fifteen minutes, the order is cancelled and refunded on its own.

steps.title: Collected — with a code.
steps.text: The rider confirms pickup with a one-time code at the counter. A rider who has not collected within thirty minutes is released, and the job passes to someone else.

steps.title: Routed along real roads.
steps.text: The route follows the streets, not a straight line, and the map is live until the rider reaches you. You hear when they are close.

steps.title: Delivered on your code, not a tap.
steps.text: Give the rider the code from your app. The order is only marked delivered when the code matches — never on a tap.

screen.title: Your delivery code
rows: Share it only with the rider

steps.title: Everyone is paid. You rate it.
steps.text: The shop and the rider are paid once the order is delivered — never before. Your rating counts toward the rider's tier.

clocks.title: Four timers run on every order.
clocks.intro: So nothing is ever left waiting on somebody else — each one ends in something happening, automatically.

items.title: To find a rider
items.text: Riders are offered it one at a time and choose. Nobody accepts by then? Cancelled and refunded.

items.title: To collect it
items.text: An accepted order not picked up passes to another rider.

items.title: To finish paying
items.text: An unpaid order is cancelled and its stock released.

items.title: From order to door
items.text: The ceiling on any order. If one runs late, you hear about it straight away.

clocks._max: max is the dial: minutes on a 60-minute face, hours on a 12-hour face — so the ring reads like a clock.

lifecycle.title: What tracking actually means here.
lifecycle.intro: The real states the platform moves an order through, in the real order — including the three that are not a happy ending.
lifecycle.unhappyTitle: When it does not go to plan
lifecycle.unhappyText: Three more states, and none of them is a dead end you have to phone about.
lifecycle.hint: Tap a step to explore it

banner.title: Work out what your order would cost.
banner.text: The same arithmetic the platform runs at checkout, to the rupee.

meta.title: Sell on QuickLocal
meta.description: Open your shop to your own neighbourhood — {freeProducts} products free, your own free-delivery threshold, and paid after every delivered order.

hero.title: Your shop, one tap from your street.
hero.intro: List what you already sell, take orders from customers a few kilometres away, and get paid after every delivered order — with every fee written down first.
hero.note: Free for up to {freeProducts} products. Change or cancel a plan any month.

documents.title: What a shop brings.
documents.intro: Checked once, before your first order. A reviewer decides each document on its own, so one blurred photo never sends the whole folder back.
documents.first: Before any of it: a bank account or UPI id, so there is somewhere to pay you, and a finished shop profile. The app names exactly what is still missing.

plans.title: Start free. Grow when it pays.

boosts.title: Put your shop in front, when you choose.
boosts.intro: A paid boost lifts one product in search, or the whole shop in local results and the home feed, for the days you choose. Your plan sets how many you can run a month — one on Growth, four on Pro — and a boosted shop is labelled Sponsored.
boosts._allowance: BoostService: boosts are bought; subscription_plans.boosts_per_month is the monthly ALLOWANCE (Free/Starter 0, Growth 1, Pro 4), not boosts given free.

banner.title: Open your shop this week.
banner.text: Install the app, choose Vendor, and the app walks you through the rest.

delivery.title: Decide when delivery is on you.
delivery.intro: Set a basket size per aisle. Above it you cover the {base} delivery base and the customer sees free delivery; below it they pay. Anything past {freeKm} km stays with the customer either way.
delivery.note: The rider is paid the whole fee either way — the only question is who funds the base.

meta.title: Deliver with QuickLocal
meta.description: Earn the order's whole delivery fee — {base} for any trip up to {freeKm} km and about ₹{perKm} a kilometre beyond — on a motorbike, scooter, auto or bicycle.

hero.title: Ride your own streets. Keep the whole fee.
hero.intro: Jobs reach you as offers, only after the shop has accepted. See the shop, the customer, both distances and the fee — accept it or pass. Deliver it, and the order's whole delivery fee is yours.

earnings.title: Slide it. That is your fee.
earnings.intro: The same arithmetic the platform runs on every order — the order's whole delivery fee is what you earn.

vehicles.title: Pick your vehicle. See your list.
vehicles.intro: The papers depend on what you ride — a bicycle needs no licence and no registration, because the state issues neither for one.
vehicles.label: Your vehicle
vehicles.payout: Before any of it: a bank account or a UPI id — either is enough — so there is somewhere to pay you.
vehicles.photos: Three photographs — front, side and back — prove it is the vehicle you declared, in the condition you declared.

tiers.title: Badges that only go up.
tiers.intro: Promoted on deliveries and stars together, the moment either changes. A job is offered to the highest tier nearby first, then the nearest rider — and a bad week never takes a badge away on its own.

items.title: Every job is an offer
items.text: A job reaches you only after the shop accepts, with the shop, the customer, both distances and the fee on screen. You have a minute to accept or pass — nothing is assigned until you say yes.

items.title: Thirty minutes to collect
items.text: An accepted job is yours for thirty minutes. Miss it and it passes on, without leaving you stuck holding it.

items.title: One order at a time
items.text: Nobody stacks a second job on your bike. One active delivery, then the next.

items.title: Codes at both ends
items.text: A code at the counter and a code at the door, so the delivery that pays you is one nobody can fake.

items.title: Paid after every drop
items.text: The fee is paid out once the order is delivered — to your bank or UPI, reconciled automatically.

items.title: No overnight demotions
items.text: A dip in rating does not take a badge away on its own. Where it matters, a person looks at it.

banner.title: Start riding this week.
banner.text: Install the app, choose Delivery Partner, and tell it what you ride.

meta.title: Trust & Safety
meta.description: How {name} keeps an order honest — verified shops and riders, codes at both ends, and money that only moves when it should.

hero.title: Built so nothing rests on a promise.
hero.intro: Every guarantee on this page is a rule the platform runs in code — not a policy somebody has to remember on a busy day.

pillars.title: Verified, document by document.
pillars.text: Every shop and every rider is checked before taking an order — against the papers their role and vehicle actually call for. Documents are checked one by one, and anything missing is named, so nobody re-uploads a whole folder to fix one page.

pillars.title: A code at the counter, and at your door.
pillars.text: The rider confirms pickup with a one-time code at the shop, and delivery with the code in your app. A delivered order is one where the codes matched — never one somebody tapped through.

pillars.title: Money that waits for the order.
pillars.text: Shops and riders are paid only after an order is delivered, and a refund is marked done only once the payment provider has actually returned it.

clocks.title: Nothing is left waiting.
clocks.intro: Every stuck state has a clock on it, and every clock ends in something happening — automatically, without a phone call.

items.title: Nothing beyond {maxRadius} km
items.text: An order can only be placed with a shop that can actually reach you — so no rider is handed an impossible trip.

items.title: A rider's number, masked
items.text: Your tracking screen never shows a rider's full phone number.

items.title: Accounts watched for abuse
items.text: Unusual activity is flagged for a person to look at, so a bad actor does not get far.

items.title: Complaints that escalate
items.text: A complaint reaches a person and is followed through, not closed quietly.

banner.title: Ask a person, not a page.
banner.text: Every message reaches someone who can answer it.

meta.title: Help Centre
meta.description: Answers about ordering, selling and delivering on {name} — every one drawn from a rule the platform enforces.

hero.title: Ask anything. Get the real rule.
hero.intro: Every answer here is a rule the platform runs, not a hopeful line — so when it says fifteen minutes, it means fifteen minutes.

search.label: Search the help centre
search.emptyText: Try a shorter word, or ask us directly.

contact.title: Still stuck?
contact.text: Write to {email} or call {phone}. A person reads every message.

events._source: Customer-facing behaviour only: events (V102/V103 — time-boxed occasions shown as a rail tab after All, each with its own page of banners) and shop offers (OfferService — product, aisle or shop-wide; percentage or flat; minimum order; cap; dated; applied at checkout). The example occasion copy is the app's own seeded example.

meta.title: Events & Offers
meta.description: Festivals, sales and late-night deals open as events in the {name} app — a tab of their own beside your aisles, with the shops' offers for the occasion.

hero.title: Every occasion gets a page of its own.
hero.intro: Festivals, seasonal sales and late-night deals arrive in the app as events — a tab right beside your aisles, full of the offers for the occasion, there only while it lasts.

rail.title: Right after All, for as long as it runs.
rail.accent: for as long as it runs.

points.title: A tab beside your aisles
points.text: A live event sits in the category rail immediately after All — one tap from wherever you are.

points.title: A page of its own
points.text: It opens its own page of banners and offers, chosen for the occasion rather than for an aisle.

points.title: Gone when it ends
points.text: Every event has a window. When it closes, the tab leaves on its own — nothing lingers past its date.

occasions.eyebrow: The kind of thing you will see
occasions.title: Occasions, not just aisles.
occasions.intro: Examples of the occasions an event is made for. Which ones run, and when, is announced in the app.

offers.title: Offers, set by the shops you know.
offers.accent: set by the shops you know.
offers.intro: Every offer comes from a shop near you, has a start and an end, and is applied to the price at checkout — there is no code to remember.

tickets.detail: Everything a shop sells in one category

offers.ticketNote: Illustrative values — each shop sets its own.

rules.title: A percentage, or a flat amount
rules.text: Some offers take a share off the price, others a fixed amount — the card says which.

rules.title: A minimum order, if the shop sets one
rules.text: Some offers start above a basket size. The offer shows it before you add a thing.

rules.title: A cap on big savings
rules.text: A percentage offer can carry a ceiling on the saving, written on the offer itself.

rules.title: Dated, start to finish
rules.text: Every offer has a start and an end. It is applied at checkout while it runs, with nothing to type.

items.title: Best deals near you
items.text: A home rail of the biggest savings within your radius.

items.title: Free delivery, past the threshold
items.text: Every shop sets a basket size above which it covers the delivery base — {threshold} until it picks its own.

items.title: ₹{referral} for every friend
items.text: Share your code; when a friend's first order lands, ₹{referral} comes off your next one.

life.title: It opens, it runs, it closes.

steps.title: It opens on its date
steps.text: The tab appears beside All the moment the window opens.

steps.title: It runs with its offers
steps.text: Its page gathers the banners and deals made for the occasion.

steps.title: It closes on its own
steps.text: When the window ends the tab leaves — and the app goes back to everyday.

banner.eyebrow: Do not miss the next one
banner.title: Events arrive in the app first.
banner.text: Turn on offer messages in the app's settings and you will hear when one opens.

app._source: Customer app (Phase-02) screens — Home, Search, Barcode scan, Stores, Saved, Inbox, Notification settings, Collections — and the backend features behind them (home feed sections V85/V92, RecommendationService, SearchService, WishlistService, AutomaticMessages, ReviewEligibilityService). Customer-facing behaviour only.

meta.title: Inside the App
meta.description: A tour of the {name} app — a home page that knows the time of day, six aisles, forgiving search, every shop that can reach you, saved items, events and offers, and a message at every step.

hero.title: Everything your street sells, in one app.
hero.intro: A tour of what a customer sees — from a home page that changes with the hour to a message at every step of an order.

steps.title: A home page that knows the hour.
steps.text: Rails of what is popular near you, the best deals within your radius, what is just in, the highly rated and the closest to you — with breakfast essentials in the morning and still-open shops for midnight cravings.

steps.title: Picked for you — for a reason.
steps.text: “Because you bought…” appears only when it is true, and never shows what is already in your cart. New here? You get what is genuinely popular nearby, and the app says so instead of pretending.

steps.title: Six aisles, each with its own look.
steps.text: Pick an aisle and the whole home page takes on its colour and its shelves — and when an event is running, its tab sits right after All.

steps.title: Search that forgives a typo.
steps.text: Suggestions as you type, results even when the spelling is off, what your city is searching for — and a scan button that finds a product from its barcode.

steps.title: Every shop that can reach you.
steps.text: Open, verified shops that deliver to where you are, nearest first. Widen the radius from {radius} to {maxRadius} km with one pill — and any promoted shop is clearly marked Sponsored.

steps.title: Save it for later.
steps.text: Heart anything to keep it. If a shop goes offline, the item stays on your list — dimmed and marked unavailable, not quietly deleted.

steps.title: Messages with the whole picture.
steps.text: A phone's notification shade shows a line and one picture. The Inbox keeps the rest — the gallery, the full text and the buttons — so an offer never loses half its story.

steps.title: You decide what pings you.
steps.text: Offers, marketing and updates switch off one by one. Orders, delivery, payments and security stay on — the messages you are actually waiting for are never silenced by accident.

messages.title: You never have to wonder.
messages.intro: The app tells you as each thing happens — and only the things you would want to know.

items.title: Order placed
items.text: Your shop has your order.

items.title: Payment successful
items.text: Paid securely through Razorpay.

items.title: The shop accepted your order
items.text: It is being packed.

items.title: A rider accepted your order
items.text: On the way to the shop.

items.title: Your rider is nearby
items.text: Keep your delivery code handy.

items.title: Delivered
items.text: Enjoy — and tell us how it went.

items.title: How was it?
items.text: Rate the shop and the rider.

messages.more: And if anything changes — running late, cancelled, a refund issued — you hear that too.

items.title: Only after delivery
items.text: You can rate a shop and a rider once your order has arrived — never before.

items.title: Within seven days
items.text: The window stays open for a week after delivery, while it is fresh.

items.title: One each, per order
items.text: One rating for the shop and one for the rider, so nobody's score is padded.

banner.title: Your street, in your pocket.
banner.text: The apps are on their way to the stores.

meta.title: Try a Sample Order
meta.description: Walk one order through {name} from aisle to doorstep — the real steps, the real delivery arithmetic and both codes. Nothing is ordered, charged or sent.

hero.title: Place an order that goes nowhere.
hero.intro: A sample order you can tap through, start to finish — the same steps, fees and codes the app uses. No shop, rider or payment is involved, and nothing leaves this page.

demo.label: Sample order
demo.illustrative: Sample shop · prices are made up
demo.freeFrom: Free delivery from {threshold} at this shop
demo.freeLeft: {left} more and the shop covers the base
demo.waitingRider: Offering the job to a rider…
demo.riderOffer: Offered to one rider at a time
demo.riderMasked: Calls are masked — neither side sees a number
demo.deliveryCodeNote: Give it only when the rider is at your door.
demo.rate: Rate the shop and the rider

steps.title: Pick an aisle
steps.text: Six aisles, and every shop in them can reach you — {radius} km out by default, up to {maxRadius} km if you widen it.
steps.rule: Search never shows a shop that cannot deliver to you.

steps.title: Fill a basket
steps.text: Shops list what they really have on the shelf, at their own prices. These four are made up for the demo.

steps.title: See every rupee first
steps.text: Delivery is worked out the way the platform does it: {base} covers the first {freeKm} km, and each kilometre beyond is charged at the day's per-km rate, rounded up to the rupee. At or over the shop's free-delivery amount, the shop pays the {base} base.
steps.rule: There is no other line on the bill — what you see here is what you pay.

steps.title: Pay — and the shop is told
steps.rule: Payment has to be finished within 30 minutes, or the order is cancelled and the stock released.

steps.title: The shop says yes
steps.rule: Only now is any rider asked.

steps.title: A rider says yes
steps.rule: Offered to one rider at a time, for a minute each. If nobody takes it within 15 minutes, the order is cancelled and refunded.

steps.title: Picked up, with a code
steps.rule: An accepted order that is not collected within 30 minutes passes to another rider.

steps.title: On its way
steps.rule: No order may take longer than {hours} hours from placing to your door.

steps.title: Your code, then it's done
steps.rule: The shop and the rider are paid only after delivery — the rider gets the whole delivery fee.

after.title: Now do it for real.
after.text: The apps are on their way to the stores. Until then, here is how each step works in more detail.
